name: Wildmane Water Well
summary: The Wildmane Water Well is the northernmost of the sacred water wells scattered across Mulgore, resting just north of the mesas of Thunder Bluff. Vital to the plains and their herds, it has become a contested flashpoint repeatedly targeted by outside opportunists and bitter exiles seeking to choke the tauren's lifeblood.

sections.title: A Lifeblood Under Siege
sections.body: For generations, the nomadic tauren have relied on sacred water wells dug across the golden plains of Mulgore to sustain their people and their wandering kodo herds. The Wildmane Well guards the northern expanse just beyond the shadow of Thunder Bluff. Its vital importance makes it an irresistible target for enemies of the tribes. Not long ago, the goblin Venture Company seized the well in a bid to monopolize the regional water supply before being driven off by tauren braves. Now, a more insidious threat lingers: the spiteful Grimtotem tribe, seeking vengeance for their exile, actively attempts to poison and taint the well.

faq.q: Where is the Wildmane Water Well located?
faq.answer: The Wildmane Water Well is situated on the plains of Mulgore, directly north of the towering mesas of Thunder Bluff. It is the northernmost of the sacred wells that sustain the region.

faq.q: Why is the well important to the tauren?
aliases: why do tauren care about the well
faq.answer: Fresh water is life on the plains. The tauren hold the land's wells sacred as vital lifelines for their settlements, traveling hunters, and the great kodo herds roaming the plains of Mulgore.

faq.q: Who has tried to sabotage or control the well?
faq.answer: The Venture Company initially occupied the well in an effort to control Mulgore's water supply, though tauren defenders drove them out. More recently, the renegade Grimtotem tribe has sought to taint the water as retribution for being banished from Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why are the Grimtotem tainting the water?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem clan harbors deep resentment after being exiled from Thunder Bluff. Rather than seeking open confrontation, they strike back through sabotage, corrupting the sacred wells to weaken the tribes and force suffering upon their rivals.

angles.text: The sacred wells of Mulgore are a gift from the Earth Mother. Defending the Wildmane Well from defilement and poison is a sacred duty for every young brave.
The Grimtotem's attempts to corrupt Mulgore's fresh water threaten the delicate balance of the plains, demanding druidic vigilance to cleanse and heal the land.
